headline: Until Dawn 2 January 28
title: Until Dawn 2 Release Date January 28 | PS5 Horror Sequel | Gaming News
video_script: Until Dawn two has a release date. The horror sequel launches on January twenty eighth, twenty twenty seven, exclusively on PlayStation 5. Firesprite is leading development, and AdHoc Studio, the team behind Dispatch, worked on the story. Pre-orders opened in September. Will you survive until dawn? Comment below!
description: Until Dawn 2 launches January 28, 2027 on PS5, developed by Firesprite with story work from AdHoc Studio. Sources: Push Square, Shacknews, GodisaGeek, Beebom.
